ingredientSections.heading: Caramelised Onion and Maple Baked Brie
items: 1 Wheel of good quality Brie like Natural Pastures Cheese Company Comox Brie
1 good Tbsp of Caramelized Onion and Maple Confit (available at The End of the Line)

methodSections.heading: Caramelised Onion and Maple Baked Brie
steps: Place the brie in a brie baker (available at The End of the Line) or similar bowl or dish. Smother the confit over the top of the brie.
Heat in a 180°C (350°F) oven for roughly 10 minutes checking regularly toward the end. It should be melted in the middle but the rind should maintain its structure.
Serve with your choice of crackers or savoury biscuits.
